Tomato Powder Price and B2B Supply Overview

For buyers evaluating competitive tomato powder pricing, Tradenest Naturals offers a reliable sourcing and manufacturing solution for high-grade dehydrated tomato powder originating from India. Sourced from carefully selected ripe tomatoes, our powder is expertly processed to deliver an authentic, concentrated tomato flavor, reliable technical performance, consistent vibrant color, and extended storage stability. As an established tomato powder manufacturer, wholesale supplier, and global exporter, we partner with food processors, industrial blenders, private-label brand owners, commercial kitchens, and distributors to provide flexible standard and customized supply programs. Contact our commercial team today to request a current tomato powder wholesale price, detailed technical data sheet, product sample, or customized export quotation.

Product Description

Tomato Powder is a finely milled, low-moisture ingredient engineered to impart natural tomato flavor, color, acidity, and total solids into diverse food formulations. It serves as an efficient, shelf-stable alternative to fresh tomatoes, purees, and pastes, significantly lowering handling requirements while enabling precise portion control and year-round supply consistency. Depending on your operational needs, we supply both conventional dehydrated tomato powder and free-flowing spray-dried tomato powder. The final carrier system, particle profile, and protective packaging are strictly matched to your exact application and agreed product specification. Our standard formulation is ideal for industrial food manufacturing and is commonly supplied as 80 mesh tomato powder, though custom fine or coarse sieve ranges are readily available to optimize product dispersion, dry-blend homogeneity, and line filling efficiency. Unless a custom formulation specifically dictates otherwise, our standard product is manufactured without artificial colors or added preservatives. All functional additives, carrier systems, anti-caking agents, or processing aids are fully disclosed and approved prior to production.

Manufacturing and Processing

Tradenest Naturals executes rigorous manufacturing protocols, encompassing raw material sourcing, optical sorting, washing, thermal dehydration or spray drying, pulverizing, precise sieving, commercial blending, quality inspection, and food-grade packaging. Raw field tomatoes undergo strict evaluation for maturity, flavor profile, color intensity, and processing suitability. Selected tomatoes are thoroughly cleaned and prepped before moisture reduction. Dehydration effectively minimizes water activity to secure long-term stability, while spray-drying techniques yield a free-flowing powder with exceptional dispersibility. Following the drying phase, the material is milled and channeled through calibrated sieves to achieve the target mesh size. Strict batch control parameters are maintained to preserve natural tomato characteristics and minimize lot-to-lot variance. Before dispatch, finished goods undergo rigorous testing against agreed-upon specifications, packaging guidelines, and destination labeling requirements. Tradenest Naturals also facilitates custom formulations, private-label retail packing, bulk industrial containers, and contract manufacturing services for buyers demanding specific flavor profiles, targeted color levels, customized carriers, or unique particle sizes.

Typical Technical Specifications

  • Form: Free-flowing, homogenous powder
  • Standard Particle Size: 80 mesh (alternative mesh sizes available upon request)
  • Typical Moisture Content: Maximum 6%, subject to final product specification
  • Typical Purity: 100% pure tomato powder for standard additive-free supply; spray-dried variants may vary based on approved functional formulations
  • Color Profile: Natural red to orange-red, influenced by seasonal raw material and processing parameters
  • Flavor and Aroma: Characteristic ripe tomato taste accompanied by mild, natural acidity
  • Packaging Integrity: Moisture-resistant, food-grade inner liner secured within robust protective outer packaging
Final technical parameters are validated via formal product specifications and batch-specific certificates issued for every order. Buyers requiring specific microbiological testing, allergen profiles, nutritional data, heavy-metal assays, or pesticide residue screenings must submit their destination market regulations prior to quotation. This ensures an appropriate analytical testing protocol and documentation package can be established without relying on generalized or unsupported laboratory claims.

Quality Assurance, Compliance, and Documentation

Our quality assurance framework relies on stringent raw material selection, strict moisture management, complete batch traceability, documented Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), mechanical sieving, packaging audits, and authorized lot release protocols. Applicable food safety standards adapt dynamically to your specific product formulation, processing pathway, regulatory destination, and importing criteria. Tradenest Naturals compiles essential export documentation, including Certificates of Analysis (CoA), technical data sheets, allergen statements, ingredient declarations, nutritional breakdowns, and Certificates of Origin. Compliance certifications must be verified for the exact facility, product SKU, and shipment prior to contract execution. Clients are welcome to submit proprietary technical specifications, retail compliance guidelines, or import checklists. Our technical team cross-references these parameters against our manufacturing capabilities to propose necessary adjustments to processing, testing, labeling, or packaging, ensuring seamless import clearance and market readiness.

Applications in Food Manufacturing

Industrial food manufacturers rely on tomato powder for its exceptional handling convenience, accurate dosing, and efficient storage properties. It can be blended directly into dry mixes or reconstituted with water and complementary ingredients to build a rich tomato base. Primary applications include:
  • Dry soup, sauce, gravy, and instant meal premixes
  • Savory seasoning blends for snack foods, extruded snacks, popcorn, noodles, pasta, and French fries
  • Bakery products, crackers, and snack crusts requiring tomato flavor enhancement or natural coloring
  • Ready-to-cook (RTC) and ready-to-eat (RTE) convenience food formulations
  • Pizza sauces, pasta bases, ketchup-style seasoning systems, and culinary spice rubs
  • Functional dry beverages, savory nutritional drinks, and specialized culinary formulations
We strongly recommend conducting application trials prior to full-scale commercial runs, as ideal usage rates vary based on targeted tomato intensity, recipe moisture levels, salt-to-acid balance, thermal processing temperatures, and powder type (dehydrated versus spray-dried). Our technical support team is available to assist with reconstitution testing, flavor profiling, blend uniformity, and cost-in-use optimization.

Buyer Value and Advantages

  • Significantly extended shelf life compared to fresh tomatoes when stored under recommended conditions
  • Substantial reductions in transport weight, freight costs, and warehouse storage footprint relative to liquid tomato pastes or purees
  • Consistent industrial dosing for automated dry blending lines and portion-controlled production
  • Highly customizable mesh sizes, functional formulations, and packaging formats tailored to specific manufacturing lines
  • Elimination of seasonal price spikes and tedious prep work, ensuring uninterrupted year-round inventory planning
  • Scalable supply chain support capable of handling bulk wholesale volumes, private-label retail lines, and complex export programs

Packaging and Shelf Life

Standard commercial packaging is available in 100 g, 250 g, 500 g, 1 kg, 5 kg, 10 kg, and 25 kg configurations to suit varying processing scales. International export buyers can request bulk corrugated boxes, multi-wall paper bags, or heavy-duty industrial bulk liners. We also accommodate stand-up pouches, PET jars, custom-printed retail packaging, and private-label configurations subject to order minimums, destination regulations, and filling specifications. All master cartons and inner liners are clearly labeled with critical traceability data, including product nomenclature, batch numbers, production dates, best-before dates, net weights, storage directives, and regulatory compliance marks. The standard shelf life is 12 months from the manufacturing date when maintained in unopened, approved packaging under recommended storage conditions. Alternative shelf-life targets can be evaluated following formal stability testing and packaging validation. Store the product in a cool, dry, and hygienic environment protected from direct sunlight, excessive heat, high humidity, strong ambient odors, and chemical contamination. Always reseal opened containers immediately and use clean, dry utensils during handling to preserve product integrity.

MOQ, Lead Times, Samples, and Quotations

What is the minimum order quantity (MOQ) for tomato powder? MOQs are determined by product availability, processing technique (dehydrated vs. spray dried), particle mesh size, packaging type, private-label requirements, and customization level. Standard bulk industrial supply typically starts at approximately 25 kg, whereas custom formulations, retail-ready pouches, and custom-printed packaging generally carry higher minimum thresholds. Final MOQs are confirmed individually following the review of your complete product specification and packing matrix. Order lead times depend on current inventory status, raw material availability, order volume, specialized testing, and destination documentation requirements. Standard stock items ship faster than custom-blended or private-label programs. To request a product sample or commercial quotation, please provide your target mesh size, formulation preferences, estimated order volume, preferred packaging format, destination country, intended application, and any unique quality or regulatory stipulations. Tradenest Naturals will promptly respond with competitive wholesale pricing, sample logistics, production schedules, and export compliance details.

Why Partner with Tradenest Naturals?

Tradenest Naturals, operating as a division of Tradenest International, is a trusted B2B manufacturer, bulk wholesale supplier, private-label partner, and export specialist for premium dehydrated foods and functional ingredients. Our integrated manufacturing infrastructure covers mechanical dehydration, spray-dried powder sourcing, pulverizing, fine grinding, precision blending, mechanical sieving, custom formulation, recipe development, bulk packing, and private-label manufacturing. Whether you require a high-volume tomato powder supplier from India, a dependable export partner, or a collaborative ingredient developer, we remain dedicated to delivering clear specifications, transparent communication, flexible packaging solutions, and exceptional commercial value.
